verdict.rationale: Featurebase documents a public developer portal with an API Reference tab, SDK (featurebase-js), and webhooks, indicating a documented public API exists for driving the product programmatically. However, no OpenAPI/swagger spec was discoverable at standard paths, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of API completeness or reliability. missing for 10: discoverable machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI/swagger), independent developer corroboration of API usage, and clearer documentation of authentication/endpoint coverage.
